findings.title: Replicas share a ReadWriteOnce claim
findings.cause: Deployment web runs 2 replicas that all mount PersistentVolumeClaim uploads, which is ReadWriteOnce: its volume attaches to one node at a time, so replicas scheduled on another node cannot start (Multi-Attach error), and rolling updates can stall the same way; it works only while they share a node

evidence.what: Deployment web has 2 replicas and mounts claim uploads
evidence.command: kubectl get deployment web -n kd-rwo-claim-shared -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}{" "}{.spec.template.spec.volumes}'

evidence.what: claim uploads has access modes ReadWriteOnce
evidence.command: kubectl get persistentvolumeclaim uploads -n kd-rwo-claim-shared -o jsonpath='{.spec.accessModes}'

findings.fix: Give each replica its own volume (a StatefulSet with volumeClaimTemplates), use a ReadWriteMany volume if they must share files, or run one replica with strategy Recreate.
